Sarah L: Heads-up — Berth private VPC change window tomorrow 01:00-03:00 UTC. Quick ops plan below. Who can be hands-on for preflight, smoke, and rollback?

Sarah L: Ops plan (brief):
- 00:30 cutoff for any staging deploys
- 00:45 preflight: networking, certs, node health
- 01:00 start config rollout + DB read-only switch
- 01:30 traffic cut + primary smoke tests
- 02:15 soak + monitoring review
- 02:45 rollback decision point (manual)
- 03:00 close window

Ming Zhao: I can own smoke + perf (us-west). Will run generator and embedding sanity. :thumbsup:

Ming Zhao: Smoke runner I'll use:
```
./run_smoke.sh --env berth --region us-west-2 --warmup 45
# checks: GET /health, POST /generate?prompt=smoke, embeddings compare
```

Jorge M: I'll take networking pre/post. Will validate peering, routes, SGs, and FWs. Will post traceroute and peering status by 00:50.

Olivia K: I'm on rollback artifacts. Rollback tag: r2026.03.17-rollback (pushed). Helm steps + manifests in runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/berth-cutover

Aarav P: I'll monitor logs and tail runtime + gateway. Need KMS decrypt for customer secrets during smoke — confirm role?

Sarah L: Aarav — you have temp decrypt role dedek. If it fails, ping @sec. Also record session for postmortem.

Ming Zhao: Preflight checklist I'll run at 00:40:
- verify model artifact checksums
- curl /health across all nodes
- confirm kv-cache warmup entries
- baseline GPU util

Jorge M: Network preflight:
- aws ec2 describe-vpc-peering-connections
- traceroute from cust-bastion -> inference-nodes
- confirm route tables, no CIDR overlap
I'll attach screenshots at 00:50 if all green.

Olivia K: Rollback abridged steps:
- `kubectl rollout pause deploy/inference`
- `helm rollback berth 3` (prepared)
- flip DB to read-write after rollback validation
- notify customer, reopen window if needed

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by @Sarah L for 2026-03-18T01:00:00Z — quiet window locked. (CI id: ci/8468)

Aarav P: If KMS errors, I'll tag @sec and escalate. Also will post CloudWatch links and a pinned dashboard.

Ming Zhao: Failure criteria (immediate rollback):
- generation p95 > 3x baseline
- embeddings similarity drop > 5% vs golden set
- any crashloop or repeated OOMs

Olivia K: Agree. If triggered, manual rollback target at 02:45. I have a fast redeploy script that completes in <10m.

Sarah L: Two asks: 1) Ming — include embedding index sanity in smoke. 2) Jorge — re-check customer FW for peering IPs (they had a deny rule last week).

Ming Zhao: Will run embedding quick-check: produce 5 vectors, cosine > 0.92 vs golden set.

Jorge M: I already requested FW exception yesterday; will re-verify at 00:35 and post proof if anything blocked.

Olivia K: Rollback image pushed to cust registry: https://registry.internal/berth/r2026.03.17-rollback (checksum verified).

Sarah L: Who will be primary for customer-facing status messages during the window? I can do initial updates but want someone to post live progress.

Jorge M: I can do network status and DM customer for confirmations.

Aarav P: I'll post live updates to #customer-berth and attach logs if smoke fails.

Ming Zhao: OK. Be in channel by 00:30 UTC. If preflight fails, call it early — no creeping.

Jorge M: I'll post preflight summary by 00:50. If I see issues earlier I'll ping.

Olivia K: Ready.

Aarav P: Ready. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2026-03-18T00:25:00Z — preflight reminder sent to participants.
